---
title: "Trade cockpit – `r params$reporter` – `r params$year`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d/%m/%Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    theme:
      version: 5
      bg: "#EEF9FD"
      fg: "#271D67"
      primary: "#1AADE7"
      secondary: "#271D67"
      base_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
      heading_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
params:
  reporter: "Luxembourg"
  reporter_code_twins: "LU"    # Trade twins: the reporter's own country code
  year: 2025
  data_path: "final_df.rds"
  top_n: 20            # partners shown in the bar charts
  heat_n: 30           # partners shown in the heatmap
  evo_default: "BE"    # partner selected when the page opens (annual evolution chart)
  threshold: 0.9       # "Product" tab: cumulative share of the flow to reach (slider in the sidebar)
  agg_path: "code_agg.xlsx"   # geographical aggregates 
  neighbours: ["BE", "FR", "NL", "DE"]   # Summary tab: neighbouring countries (summed)
  excluded_products: ["99"]              # Summary tab: chapters is excluded of the top 5 (besides TOTAL)
  hs4_path: "2025_4digits.json"          # Summary tab: 4-digit file (Eurostat JSON-stat) for the top 5 drilldown; "" = no drilldown
  hs4_n: 8                               # Summary tab: 4-digit details shown per chapter (>= 1% of the chapter), the rest folded
  data_eu: "eu27_df.rds"       # Trade twins: the other EU countries x WORLD x HS2 (REPORTER_CODE column); "" = tab disabled
  twins_rows: 10               # Trade twins: chapters shown in the basket chart before folding the rest
  twins_countries: 12          # Trade twins: countries shown in the product picker
  topojson_url: ""     
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

need <- c("tidyverse", "knitr", "plotly", "htmltools", "bslib", "DT", "jsonlite", "crosstalk", "readxl")
missing_pkgs <- need[!need %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(crosstalk)
library(readxl)

# Artemis graphic charter
COL_BG      <- "#EEF9FD"
COL_NAVY    <- "#271D67"   
COL_BLUE    <- "#1AADE7"  
COL_LAVEND  <- "#7B6FD0"
COL_GREY    <- "#8A87A8"
COL_RED     <- "#D7263D"
FONT_FAMILY <- "Poppins, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif"

# Flow colours
FLOW_COLORS <- c(IMPORT = "#0E8FC2", EXPORT = "#D97A06")
FLOW_LABELS <- c(IMPORT = "Imports", EXPORT = "Exports")

# Sequential scale for magnitudes (one hue, light -> dark)
SEQ_SCALE <- list(c(0, "#E6F4FB"), c(0.25, "#A9DCF3"), c(0.5, "#1AADE7"), c(0.75, "#0E6FA6"), c(1, "#271D67"))

KEY_SEP <- "||"

# Crosstalk: the map and the "annual evolution" chart share one selection group, keyed by partner code
CT_GROUP  <- "partner"
SANKEY_N  <- 12 # number displayed in sankey graph
```

```{r load-data}

if (exists("final_df", envir = globalenv(), inherits = FALSE)) {
  final_df <- get("final_df", envir = globalenv())
} else if (nzchar(params$data_path) && file.exists(params$data_path)) {
  final_df <- readRDS(params$data_path)
} else {
  stop(
    "final_df not found.\n"
  )
}

needed <- c("PRODUCT_CODE", "PRODUCT_LABEL", "FLOW_LABEL", "PARTNER_CODE", "PARTNER_LABEL", "TIME", "VALUE_IN_EUROS")
if (!all(needed %in% names(final_df))) {
  stop("final_df is missing column(s): ", paste(setdiff(needed, names(final_df)), collapse = ", "))
}

ISO_A3 <- c(
  AD="AND", AE="ARE", AF="AFG", AG="ATG", AI="AIA", AL="ALB", AM="ARM", AO="AGO", AQ="ATA",
  AR="ARG", AS="ASM", AT="AUT", AU="AUS", AW="ABW", AX="ALA", AZ="AZE", BA="BIH", BB="BRB",
  BD="BGD", BE="BEL", BF="BFA", BG="BGR", BH="BHR", BI="BDI", BJ="BEN", BL="BLM", BM="BMU",
  BN="BRN", BO="BOL", BQ="BES", BR="BRA", BS="BHS", BT="BTN", BV="BVT", BW="BWA", BY="BLR",
  BZ="BLZ", CA="CAN", CC="CCK", CD="COD", CF="CAF", CG="COG", CH="CHE", CI="CIV", CK="COK",
  CL="CHL", CM="CMR", CN="CHN", CO="COL", CR="CRI", CU="CUB", CV="CPV", CW="CUW", CX="CXR",
  CY="CYP", CZ="CZE", DE="DEU", DJ="DJI", DK="DNK", DM="DMA", DO="DOM", DZ="DZA", EC="ECU",
  EE="EST", EG="EGY", EH="ESH", ER="ERI", ES="ESP", ET="ETH", FI="FIN", FJ="FJI", FK="FLK",
  FM="FSM", FO="FRO", FR="FRA", GA="GAB", GB="GBR", GD="GRD", GE="GEO", GF="GUF", GG="GGY",
  GH="GHA", GI="GIB", GL="GRL", GM="GMB", GN="GIN", GP="GLP", GQ="GNQ", GR="GRC", GS="SGS",
  GT="GTM", GU="GUM", GW="GNB", GY="GUY", HK="HKG", HM="HMD", HN="HND", HR="HRV", HT="HTI",
  HU="HUN", ID="IDN", IE="IRL", IL="ISR", IM="IMN", IN="IND", IO="IOT", IQ="IRQ", IR="IRN",
  IS="ISL", IT="ITA", JE="JEY", JM="JAM", JO="JOR", JP="JPN", KE="KEN", KG="KGZ", KH="KHM",
  KI="KIR", KM="COM", KN="KNA", KP="PRK", KR="KOR", KW="KWT", KY="CYM", KZ="KAZ", LA="LAO",
  LB="LBN", LC="LCA", LI="LIE", LK="LKA", LR="LBR", LS="LSO", LT="LTU", LU="LUX", LV="LVA",
  LY="LBY", MA="MAR", MC="MCO", MD="MDA", ME="MNE", MF="MAF", MG="MDG", MH="MHL", MK="MKD",
  ML="MLI", MM="MMR", MN="MNG", MO="MAC", MP="MNP", MQ="MTQ", MR="MRT", MS="MSR", MT="MLT",
  MU="MUS", MV="MDV", MW="MWI", MX="MEX", MY="MYS", MZ="MOZ", NC="NCL", NE="NER", NF="NFK",
  NG="NGA", NI="NIC", NL="NLD", NO="NOR", NP="NPL", NR="NRU", NU="NIU", NZ="NZL", OM="OMN",
  PA="PAN", PE="PER", PF="PYF", PG="PNG", PH="PHL", PK="PAK", PL="POL", PM="SPM", PN="PCN",
  PR="PRI", PS="PSE", PT="PRT", PW="PLW", PY="PRY", QA="QAT", RE="REU", RO="ROU", RS="SRB",
  RU="RUS", RW="RWA", SA="SAU", SB="SLB", SC="SYC", SD="SDN", SE="SWE", SG="SGP", SH="SHN",
  SI="SVN", SJ="SJM", SK="SVK", SL="SLE", SM="SMR", SN="SEN", SO="SOM", SR="SUR", SS="SSD",
  ST="STP", SV="SLV", SX="SXM", SY="SYR", SZ="SWZ", TC="TCA", TD="TCD", TF="ATF", TG="TGO",
  TH="THA", TJ="TJK", TK="TKL", TL="TLS", TM="TKM", TN="TUN", TO="TON", TR="TUR", TT="TTO",
  TV="TUV", TW="TWN", TZ="TZA", UA="UKR", UG="UGA", UM="UMI", US="USA", UY="URY", UZ="UZB",
  VA="VAT", VC="VCT", VE="VEN", VG="VGB", VI="VIR", VN="VNM", VU="VUT", WF="WLF", WS="WSM",
  YE="YEM", YT="MYT", ZA="ZAF", ZM="ZMB", ZW="ZWE", "NA"="NAM",
  # Eurostat-specific codes
  EL="GRC", UK="GBR", XK="XKX", XS="SRB", XM="MNE"
)

# Territories kept as separate partners
EXTRA_PARTNERS <- c("XC", "XL") # Ceuta, Melilla
partner_keep   <- c(names(ISO_A3), EXTRA_PARTNERS)

raw_all <- final_df %>%
  mutate(
    PARTNER_CODE = if_else(is.na(PARTNER_CODE), "NA", as.character(PARTNER_CODE)),  # Namibia
    TIME         = as.integer(TIME),
    VALUE        = as.numeric(VALUE_IN_EUROS),
    FLOW         = toupper(FLOW_LABEL)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), FLOW %in% names(FLOW_COLORS))

raw <- filter(raw_all, TIME == params$year)
if (nrow(raw) == 0) stop("No row for year ", params$year, " in final_df")

excluded_codes <- raw %>%
  filter(!PARTNER_CODE %in% partner_keep) %>%
  distinct(PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER_LABEL) %>%
  arrange(PARTNER_CODE)

trade_all <- raw_all %>%
  filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% partner_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    ISO3    = unname(ISO_A3[PARTNER_CODE]),          # NA for the extra territories
    # "Belgium (incl. Luxembourg 'LU' -> 1998)" -> "Belgium"
    PARTNER = str_squish(str_remove(PARTNER_LABEL, "\\s*\\(.*$"))
  )
trade <- filter(trade_all, TIME == params$year)
years_all <- sort(unique(trade_all$TIME))

# ---- Products ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
has_total <- "TOTAL" %in% trade$PRODUCT_CODE

products <- trade %>%
  filter(PRODUCT_CODE != "TOTAL") %>%
  distinct(PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_LABEL) %>%
  arrange(PRODUCT_CODE) %>%
  mutate(PRODUCT_NAME = str_to_sentence(PRODUCT_LABEL),
         PRODUCT_NAME = if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 60, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 57), "..."), PRODUCT_NAME),
         PRODUCT_OPT  = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", PRODUCT_NAME))

by_partner <- trade %>%
  filter(PRODUCT_CODE != "TOTAL") %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
  summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

total_rows <- if (has_total) {
  trade %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL") %>%
    group_by(FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
    summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  by_partner %>% group_by(FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
    summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
}
by_partner <- bind_rows(by_partner, mutate(total_rows, PRODUCT_CODE = "TOTAL")) %>%
  filter(VALUE > 0)

product_keys <- c("TOTAL", products$PRODUCT_CODE)
product_names <- c(TOTAL = "All products", setNames(products$PRODUCT_NAME, products$PRODUCT_CODE))

flow_totals <- by_partner %>% group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>% summarise(TOTAL = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Partner concentration per product -------------------------------------------------------
# Partners ranked by value within each product x flow, with their cumulative share of the flow.
# The number of partners dependence to reach a threshold = first rank whose cumulative share >= threshold.
conc <- by_partner %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE), CUM = cumsum(SHARE), RANK = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

n_to_reach <- function(cum, thr) { i <- which(cum >= thr - 1e-9); if (length(i)) i[1] else length(cum) }

conc_summary <- conc %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  summarise(
    TOTAL    = sum(VALUE),
    PARTNERS = n(),
    N_THR    = n_to_reach(CUM, params$threshold),
    TOP1     = first(PARTNER),
    TOP1_SH  = first(SHARE),
    TOP3_SH  = sum(head(SHARE, 3)),
    HHI      = sum(SHARE^2),
    COUNTRIES = paste(head(PARTNER_CODE, N_THR), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(PRODUCT_NAME = if_else(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL", "All products", PRODUCT_NAME),
         LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", PRODUCT_NAME))
```

```{r helpers}
fmt_eur <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x)        ~ "–",
    abs(x) >= 1e9   ~ sprintf("%.2f bn €", x / 1e9),
    abs(x) >= 1e6   ~ sprintf("%.1f M€", x / 1e6),
    abs(x) >= 1e3   ~ sprintf("%.0f k€", x / 1e3),
    TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.0f €", x)
  )
}
fmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x))
key_of  <- function(product, flow) paste(product, flow, sep = KEY_SEP)

theme_plotly <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      font          = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, color = COL_NAVY),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor  = "#FFFFFF",
      hoverlabel    = list(font = list(family = FONT_FAMILY))
    ) %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d"),
           topojsonURL = if (nzchar(params$topojson_url)) params$topojson_url else NULL)
}
axis_style <- list(gridcolor = "#DDEFF8", zerolinecolor = "#C9C4EC", linecolor = COL_NAVY)

keyed <- function(p, keys, keyby, height) {
  p$height <- height
  div(class = "keyed", `data-keys` = toJSON(keys), `data-keyby` = keyby, p)
}

kpi <- function(id, label, note = "") {
  div(class = "kpi", div(class = "kpi-value", id = paste0("kpi-", id), "–"),
      div(class = "kpi-label", label), div(class = "kpi-note", id = paste0("kpi-", id, "-note"), note))
}
```

```{r kpis}
kpi_tbl <- by_partner %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    total     = sum(VALUE),
    partners  = n(),
    top1      = first(PARTNER),
    top1_sh   = first(VALUE) / sum(VALUE),
    top5_sh   = sum(head(VALUE, 5)) / sum(VALUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

balance_tbl <- flow_totals %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = TOTAL, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(balance = EXPORT - IMPORT, cover = if_else(IMPORT > 0, EXPORT / IMPORT, NA_real_))

kpi_json <- kpi_tbl %>%
  left_join(balance_tbl, by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(
    key       = key_of(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW),
    total_f   = fmt_eur(total),
    top1_f    = top1,
    top1_note = paste0(fmt_pct(top1_sh), " of the flow"),
    top5_f    = fmt_pct(top5_sh),
    balance_f = paste0(if_else(balance >= 0, "+", "−"), fmt_eur(abs(balance))),
    balance_note = if_else(is.na(cover), "", sprintf("exports / imports = %.2f", cover))
  ) %>%
  select(key, total_f, partners, top1_f, top1_note, top5_f, balance_f, balance_note) %>%
  split(.$key) %>%
  map(~ as.list(.x[1, -1]))
```

```{r widgets}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. WORLD MAP
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
map_data <- by_partner %>%
  filter(!is.na(ISO3)) %>%
  left_join(flow_totals, by = c("PRODUCT_CODE", "FLOW")) %>%
  mutate(Z = log10(VALUE), SHARE = VALUE / TOTAL,
         HOVER = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s<br>Share of the flow: %s", PARTNER, FLOW_LABELS[FLOW], fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)))

z_rng <- c(3, ceiling(max(map_data$Z)))
cb_ticks <- seq(z_rng[1], z_rng[2], by = 1)
cb_text  <- fmt_eur(10^cb_ticks)

map_keys <- character(0)
p_map <- plot_geo()
for (pk in product_keys) for (fl in names(FLOW_COLORS)) {
  d <- filter(map_data, PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == fl)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  map_keys <- c(map_keys, key_of(pk, fl))
  p_map <- p_map %>% add_trace(
    type = "choropleth", data = d,
    customdata = ~PARTNER_CODE,
    locations = ~ISO3, z = ~Z, text = ~HOVER, hoverinfo = "text",
    colorscale = SEQ_SCALE, zmin = z_rng[1], zmax = z_rng[2],
    marker = list(line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
    colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Value (log scale)", font = list(size = 11)),
                    tickvals = cb_ticks, ticktext = cb_text, len = 0.7, thickness = 12,
                    outlinewidth = 0, x = 1.0),
    visible = (pk == "TOTAL" && fl == "IMPORT")
  )
}
p_map <- p_map %>%
  layout(
    geo = list(projection = list(type = "natural earth"), showframe = FALSE, showcoastlines = FALSE,
               showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#DDEFF8", landcolor = "#F4F6FA",
               showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#FFFFFF", bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
               lataxis = list(range = c(-58, 85))),
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 10, b = 0)
  ) %>%
  add_trace(
    type = "choropleth", locations = list(), z = list(),
    colorscale = list(c(0, COL_RED), c(1, COL_RED)), showscale = FALSE,
    marker = list(opacity = 0.45, line = list(color = COL_RED, width = 3)), hoverinfo = "skip", name = "selected"
  ) %>%
  theme_plotly()

# ---- Geographical aggregates (code_agg.xlsx) --------------------------------------------------
CODE_ALIAS <- c(RS = "XS", XS = "RS", ME = "XM", XM = "ME", GR = "EL", EL = "GR", GB = "UK", UK = "GB")
to_data_code <- function(codes) {
  out <- ifelse(codes %in% partner_names$PARTNER_CODE, codes,
                ifelse(CODE_ALIAS[codes] %in% partner_names$PARTNER_CODE, CODE_ALIAS[codes], NA_character_))
  unique(na.omit(unname(out)))
}
parse_codes <- function(note) {
  if (is.na(note) || !str_detect(note, ":")) return(character(0))
  str_remove(note, "^[^:]*:") %>% str_replace_all("\\band\\b", ",") %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist() %>%
    str_trim() %>% str_remove_all("[\\.;]") %>% keep(~ str_detect(.x, "^[A-Z]{2}$"))
}

aggregates <- tibble(CODE = character(0), NAME = character(0), MEMBERS = list())
agg_status <- if (!nzchar(params$agg_path)) "no aggregate file set (params$agg_path)" else
  if (!file.exists(params$agg_path)) sprintf("aggregate file not found: %s (working directory: %s)", params$agg_path, getwd()) else "ok"
if (agg_status != "ok") warning("Regions unavailable: ", agg_status)
if (agg_status == "ok") {
  agg_raw <- read_excel(params$agg_path, col_types = "text")
  col_of <- function(motif) { nm <- names(agg_raw)[str_detect(tolower(names(agg_raw)), motif)][1]; if (is.na(nm)) stop("code_agg: column not found: ", motif); nm }
  agg_raw <- agg_raw %>% transmute(CODE = str_trim(.data[[col_of("^code$")]]), NAME = str_trim(.data[[col_of("^label")]]),
                                   NOTE = .data[[col_of("^note")]]) %>% filter(!is.na(CODE), CODE != "")
  members <- setNames(lapply(agg_raw$NOTE, function(n) to_data_code(parse_codes(n))), agg_raw$CODE)
  find_agg <- function(code) {
    cand <- c(code, str_remove(code, "_\\d{4}$"), names(members)[startsWith(code, names(members))])
    cand <- cand[cand %in% names(members)]
    if (length(cand)) cand[1] else NA_character_
  }
  for (i in which(str_detect(agg_raw$NOTE, "^\\s*="))) {
    terms <- agg_raw$NOTE[i] %>% str_remove("^\\s*=") %>% str_remove("(?i)contenu de") %>% str_split("-") %>% unlist() %>% str_trim()
    terms <- terms[terms != ""]
    resolve <- function(t) { a <- find_agg(t); if (!is.na(a)) members[[a]] else to_data_code(t) }
    set <- resolve(terms[1])
    for (t in terms[-1]) set <- setdiff(set, resolve(t))
    members[[agg_raw$CODE[i]]] <- set
  }
  aggregates <- tibble(CODE = agg_raw$CODE, NAME = agg_raw$NAME, MEMBERS = unname(members)) %>%
    filter(lengths(MEMBERS) > 0)
}

# 1c. SANKEY - origins -> Luxembourg -> destinations for the selected product (one trace per product).
#     Left = where the imports come from, right = where the exports go; width = value.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rgba <- function(hex, a) { r <- col2rgb(hex); sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", r[1], r[2], r[3], a) }

sankey_side <- function(d, other_lbl) {
  d <- arrange(d, desc(VALUE))
  if (nrow(d) > SANKEY_N) {
    d <- bind_rows(head(d, SANKEY_N),
                   tibble(PARTNER = other_lbl, VALUE = sum(d$VALUE[-(1:SANKEY_N)])))
  }
  d
}

p_sankey <- plot_ly()
sankey_keys <- character(0)
for (pk in product_keys) {
  imp <- by_partner %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == "IMPORT") %>% select(PARTNER, VALUE) %>%
    sankey_side(sprintf("Other origins"))
  exp <- by_partner %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == "EXPORT") %>% select(PARTNER, VALUE) %>%
    sankey_side(sprintf("Other destinations"))
  if (nrow(imp) + nrow(exp) == 0) next
  sankey_keys <- c(sankey_keys, pk)

  nodes <- c(imp$PARTNER, params$reporter, exp$PARTNER)
  i_lu  <- nrow(imp)
  src   <- c(seq_len(nrow(imp)) - 1, rep(i_lu, nrow(exp)))
  tgt   <- c(rep(i_lu, nrow(imp)), i_lu + seq_len(nrow(exp)))
  val   <- c(imp$VALUE, exp$VALUE)
  link_flow <- c(rep("IMPORT", nrow(imp)), rep("EXPORT", nrow(exp)))
  link_lbl  <- c(sprintf("%s → %s<br>Imports: %s (%s of imports)", imp$PARTNER, params$reporter, fmt_eur(imp$VALUE), fmt_pct(imp$VALUE / sum(imp$VALUE))),
                 sprintf("%s → %s<br>Exports: %s (%s of exports)", params$reporter, exp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(exp$VALUE), fmt_pct(exp$VALUE / sum(exp$VALUE))))
  node_lbl  <- c(sprintf("%s<br>Imports: %s", imp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(imp$VALUE)),
                 sprintf("%s<br>Imports: %s · Exports: %s", params$reporter, fmt_eur(sum(imp$VALUE)), fmt_eur(sum(exp$VALUE))),
                 sprintf("%s<br>Exports: %s", exp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(exp$VALUE)))
  node_col  <- c(rep(FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]], nrow(imp)), COL_NAVY, rep(FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], nrow(exp)))
  node_x    <- c(rep(0.01, nrow(imp)), 0.5, rep(0.99, nrow(exp)))

  p_sankey <- p_sankey %>% add_trace(
    type = "sankey", arrangement = "snap", orientation = "h",
    node = list(label = nodes, color = node_col, pad = 10, thickness = 16,
                line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1),
                customdata = node_lbl, hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"),
    link = list(source = src, target = tgt, value = val,
                color = ifelse(link_flow == "IMPORT", rgba(FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]], 0.35), rgba(FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], 0.35)),
                customdata = link_lbl, hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"),
    textfont = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = 11, color = COL_NAVY),
    visible = (pk == "TOTAL")
  )
}
```

```{r twins-data}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRADE TWINS - which EU countries have a trade profile like Luxembourg's? (from trade_dna_KA.Rmd)
# Similarity = Finger-Kreinin index on HS2 shares of the trade with the WORLD:
#   FK(LU, c) = sum_i min(s_LU,i , s_c,i)   (0 = nothing in common, 1 = identical mix)
# Needs params$data_eu: the other EU countries as reporters x partner WORLD x HS2 chapters x flows.
# Everything is computed for every flow x year once; the page swaps the data of the charts.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_eu <- function(path) {
  if (!nzchar(path)) return(NA_character_)
  cand <- unique(c(path, file.path("data", basename(path)), file.path("../data", basename(path))))
  hit <- cand[file.exists(cand)]; if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}
eu_path <- find_eu(params$data_eu)
has_twins <- !is.na(eu_path)
if (!has_twins) warning("Trade twins unavailable: file not found (params$data_eu = ", params$data_eu, ", working directory ", getwd(), ")")

twins_status <- if (has_twins) "ok" else sprintf("comparison file not found: %s", params$data_eu)
if (has_twins) {
  eu_raw <- if (grepl("\\.rds$", eu_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) readRDS(eu_path) else read.csv(eu_path, colClasses = "character")
  eu_raw <- as.data.frame(eu_raw); names(eu_raw) <- toupper(names(eu_raw))
  pick <- function(...) { c <- intersect(c(...), names(eu_raw)); if (length(c)) eu_raw[[c[1]]] else NULL }
  eu_df <- tibble(REPORTER = as.character(pick("REPORTER_CODE", "REPORTER", "DECLARANT", "GEO")),
                  PARTNER  = as.character(pick("PARTNER_CODE", "PARTNER")),
                  PRODUCT  = as.character(pick("PRODUCT_CODE", "PRODUCT")),
                  FLOW     = as.character(pick("FLOW_CODE", "FLOW")),
                  FLOW_LABEL = { f <- pick("FLOW_LABEL"); if (is.null(f)) NA_character_ else as.character(f) },
                  TIME     = as.integer(pick("TIME", "PERIOD", "YEAR")),
                  VALUE    = as.numeric(pick("VALUE_IN_EUROS", "VALUE", "OBS_VALUE"))) %>%
    mutate(FLOW = case_when(toupper(FLOW_LABEL) %in% c("IMPORT", "EXPORT") ~ toupper(FLOW_LABEL),
                            FLOW %in% c("1", "IMPORT") ~ "IMPORT", FLOW %in% c("2", "EXPORT") ~ "EXPORT", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(VALUE), !is.na(FLOW), PARTNER == "WORLD", str_detect(PRODUCT, "^[0-9]{2}$"), VALUE > 0,
           REPORTER != params$reporter_code_twins)
  # Luxembourg: its own trade with the WORLD, same chapters (sum of the countries when WORLD is absent)
  lu_df <- (if (has_world) world_rows else trade_all) %>%
    filter(str_detect(PRODUCT_CODE, "^[0-9]{2}$")) %>%
    group_by(PRODUCT = PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(REPORTER = params$reporter_code_twins)
  hs2_all <- bind_rows(select(lu_df, REPORTER, PRODUCT, FLOW, TIME, VALUE),
                       eu_df %>% group_by(REPORTER, PRODUCT, FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")) %>%
    filter(!PRODUCT %in% unlist(params$excluded_products))
  tw_shares <- hs2_all %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE)) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-VALUE)
  # every (flow, year) x other country x chapter, 0 where a country has nothing, next to Luxembourg's share
  tw_overlap <- tw_shares %>%
    complete(nesting(FLOW, TIME), REPORTER, PRODUCT, fill = list(SHARE = 0)) %>%
    group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% filter(sum(SHARE) > 0) %>% ungroup()
  tw_focus <- tw_overlap %>% filter(REPORTER == params$reporter_code_twins) %>% select(FLOW, TIME, PRODUCT, SHARE_FOCUS = SHARE)
  tw_overlap <- tw_overlap %>% filter(REPORTER != params$reporter_code_twins) %>%
    inner_join(tw_focus, by = c("FLOW", "TIME", "PRODUCT")) %>%
    mutate(COMMON = pmin(SHARE, SHARE_FOCUS), GAP = abs(SHARE - SHARE_FOCUS))
  tw_years <- sort(unique(tw_overlap$TIME))
  if (length(tw_years) == 0) { has_twins <- FALSE; twins_status <- "no year in common between final_df (WORLD rows) and the comparison file" }
}
if (has_twins) {
  # names of the reporters: Luxembourg's partner labels (with the EL/GR, UK/GB aliases), else the code
  tw_name <- function(code) {
    n <- partner_names$PARTNER[match(code, partner_names$PARTNER_CODE)]
    n2 <- partner_names$PARTNER[match(unname(CODE_ALIAS[code]), partner_names$PARTNER_CODE)]
    out <- ifelse(is.na(n), n2, n); ifelse(is.na(out), code, out)
  }
  tw_iso3 <- function(code) { i <- unname(ISO_A3[code]); i2 <- unname(ISO_A3[unname(CODE_ALIAS[code])]); ifelse(is.na(i), i2, i) }
  tw_fk <- tw_overlap %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% summarise(FK = sum(COMMON), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(FLOW, TIME, desc(FK), REPORTER)
  NR <- params$twins_rows
  # basket: per flow x year x country, the NR chapters with the largest combined weight, the rest folded into "Other chapters"
  tw_basket <- tw_overlap %>% filter(SHARE > 0 | SHARE_FOCUS > 0) %>%
    group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% arrange(desc(SHARE + SHARE_FOCUS), PRODUCT, .by_group = TRUE) %>% mutate(ROW = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
  tw_basket <- bind_rows(
    tw_basket %>% filter(ROW <= NR),
    tw_basket %>% filter(ROW > NR) %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>%
      summarise(PRODUCT = sprintf("Other chapters (%d)", n()), SHARE_FOCUS = sum(SHARE_FOCUS), SHARE = sum(SHARE), COMMON = sum(COMMON), ROW = NR + 1L, .groups = "drop")) %>%
    arrange(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER, ROW)
  tw_top3 <- tw_overlap %>% filter(COMMON > 0) %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% arrange(desc(COMMON), PRODUCT, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 3) %>% ungroup()
  tw_gap  <- tw_overlap %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, REPORTER) %>% arrange(desc(GAP), PRODUCT, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
  # product picker: per flow x year x chapter, the countries closest to Luxembourg on that chapter
  tw_picker <- tw_overlap %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME, PRODUCT) %>% arrange(GAP, REPORTER, .by_group = TRUE) %>% slice_head(n = params$twins_countries) %>% ungroup()
  tw_products <- tw_focus %>% filter(SHARE_FOCUS > 0) %>% arrange(FLOW, TIME, desc(SHARE_FOCUS))
  # heatmap: per flow x year, the NR chapters that tie the 5 closest twins most (no "Other chapters" row)
  tw_heat <- lapply(split(tw_fk, tw_fk$FLOW), function(f) lapply(split(f, f$TIME), function(s) {
    top <- head(s$REPORTER, 5)
    m <- tw_overlap %>% filter(FLOW == s$FLOW[1], TIME == s$TIME[1], REPORTER %in% top) %>%
      select(PRODUCT, REPORTER, COMMON) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = REPORTER, values_from = COMMON, values_fill = 0)
    m <- m[, c("PRODUCT", top[top %in% names(m)]), drop = FALSE]
    m <- m %>% mutate(TOTAL = rowSums(across(-PRODUCT))) %>% filter(TOTAL > 0) %>% arrange(desc(TOTAL), PRODUCT) %>% select(-TOTAL) %>% slice_head(n = NR)
    list(cols = I(names(m)[-1]), rows = I(m$PRODUCT), z = unname(as.matrix(m[, -1])))
  }))
  tw_names <- { k <- unique(tw_fk$REPORTER); as.list(setNames(tw_name(k), k)) }
  tw_iso   <- { k <- unique(tw_fk$REPORTER); as.list(setNames(tw_iso3(k), k)) }
  tw_hs2   <- as.list(setNames(products$PRODUCT_NAME, products$PRODUCT_CODE))
  tw_year0 <- if (params$year %in% tw_years) params$year else max(tw_years)
  take <- function(d, ...) { d <- as.data.frame(d)[, c(...), drop = FALSE]; rownames(d) <- NULL; d }
  nest <- function(df, keys, leaf) { if (!length(keys)) return(leaf(df)); lapply(split(df, df[[keys[1]]], drop = TRUE), function(d) nest(d, keys[-1], leaf)) }
  TWINS <- list(
    focus = params$reporter_code_twins, focusName = params$reporter, year = tw_year0, years = I(tw_years), nRows = NR,
    names = tw_names, iso3 = tw_iso, hs2 = tw_hs2,
    fk      = nest(tw_fk, c("FLOW", "TIME"), function(d) take(d, "REPORTER", "FK")),
    basket  = nest(tw_basket, c("FLOW", "TIME", "REPORTER"), function(d) take(d, "PRODUCT", "SHARE_FOCUS", "SHARE", "COMMON")),
    top3    = nest(tw_top3, c("FLOW", "TIME", "REPORTER"), function(d) take(d, "PRODUCT", "COMMON")),
    gap     = nest(tw_gap, c("FLOW", "TIME", "REPORTER"), function(d) take(d, "PRODUCT", "SHARE_FOCUS", "SHARE")),
    heat    = tw_heat,
    products = nest(tw_products, c("FLOW", "TIME"), function(d) take(d, "PRODUCT", "SHARE_FOCUS")),
    picker  = nest(tw_picker, c("FLOW", "TIME", "PRODUCT"), function(d) take(d, "REPORTER", "SHARE", "SHARE_FOCUS", "GAP", "COMMON"))
  )
  # ---- placeholders, drawn for the opening flow (imports) and year ------------------------------
  fk0 <- tw_fk %>% filter(FLOW == "IMPORT", TIME == tw_year0) %>% mutate(ISO3 = tw_iso3(REPORTER), NAME = tw_name(REPORTER)) %>% filter(!is.na(ISO3))
  p_tw_map <- plot_geo() %>%
    add_trace(type = "choropleth", locations = fk0$ISO3, z = fk0$FK, text = fk0$NAME, zmin = 0, zmax = 1, colorscale = SEQ_SCALE,
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>Similarity %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>",
              marker = list(line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
              colorbar = list(title = list(text = "FK index", font = list(size = 11)), thickness = 12, len = 0.6, outlinewidth = 0)) %>%
    add_trace(type = "scattergeo", mode = "markers", locations = unname(ISO_A3[params$reporter_code_twins]),
              marker = list(size = 14, color = COL_RED, line = list(width = 2, color = "#FFFFFF")), name = params$reporter, hoverinfo = "name", showlegend = FALSE) %>%
    layout(geo = list(scope = "europe", projection = list(type = "natural earth"), bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                      lataxis = list(range = c(34, 71)), lonaxis = list(range = c(-25, 40)), showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#C9C4EC",
                      landcolor = "#F4F6FA", showcoastlines = FALSE, showframe = FALSE, showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#FFFFFF"),
           margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 10, b = 0)) %>% theme_plotly()
  # butterfly: 4 traces (common | only focus | common | only twin), refilled by the page
  TW_COMMON <- COL_NAVY; TW_ONLY <- "#C9C4EC"
  p_tw_bfly <- plot_ly()
  for (k in 1:4) p_tw_bfly <- p_tw_bfly %>% add_trace(type = "bar", orientation = "h", x = list(), y = list(), customdata = list(),
      name = c("In common (adds up to the score)", "Only in one basket", "In common", "Only in one basket")[k], showlegend = k <= 2,
      marker = list(color = if (k %in% c(1, 3)) TW_COMMON else TW_ONLY, line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
      text = list(), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE, textfont = list(size = 11, color = COL_NAVY))
  p_tw_bfly <- p_tw_bfly %>% layout(barmode = "relative", bargap = 0.28, hovermode = "closest",
      xaxis = c(axis_style, list(range = c(-50, 50), zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = COL_NAVY, zerolinewidth = 1)),
      yaxis = list(range = c(NR + 1.6, 0.4), tickvals = list(), ticktext = list(), showgrid = FALSE, ticks = "", automargin = TRUE),
      annotations = list(list(x = 0.25, y = 1, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, text = paste0("<b>", params$reporter, "</b>"), font = list(size = 14)),
                         list(x = 0.75, y = 1, xref = "paper", yref = "paper", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, text = "", font = list(size = 14))),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", yanchor = "top", y = -0.06, xanchor = "center", x = 0.5, font = list(size = 11)),
      margin = list(l = 10, r = 40, t = 40, b = 10)) %>% theme_plotly()
  p_tw_heat <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(type = "heatmap", x = list(), y = list(), z = list(), xgap = 3, ygap = 3, colorscale = SEQ_SCALE, zmin = 0, zmax = 10,
              hovertemplate = paste0("<b>%{y}</b><br>%{x} and ", params$reporter, " share <b>%{z:.1f} points</b><extra></extra>"),
              colorbar = list(title = list(text = "points", font = list(size = 11)), thickness = 12, len = 0.7, outlinewidth = 0)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = list(side = "top", showgrid = FALSE, ticks = "", type = "category"),
           yaxis = list(autorange = "reversed", showgrid = FALSE, ticks = "", automargin = TRUE, type = "category"),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 60, b = 10)) %>% theme_plotly()
  p_tw_pick <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(type = "bar", orientation = "h", x = list(), y = list(), customdata = list(), showlegend = FALSE,
              marker = list(color = list(), line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
              text = list(), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE, textfont = list(size = 11, color = COL_NAVY)) %>%
    layout(bargap = 0.35, hovermode = "closest",
           xaxis = c(axis_style, list(range = c(0, 10), ticksuffix = " %", zeroline = FALSE, title = list(text = ""))),
           yaxis = list(range = c(params$twins_countries + 0.6, 0.4), tickvals = list(), ticktext = list(), showgrid = FALSE, ticks = "", automargin = TRUE),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = 0, x1 = 0, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, xref = "x", yref = "paper", line = list(color = COL_RED, width = 2, dash = "dash"))),
           annotations = list(list(x = 0, y = 1, xref = "x", yref = "paper", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, text = "", font = list(size = 12, color = COL_RED))),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 80, t = 40, b = 30)) %>% theme_plotly()
}
```

```{r summary}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TAB - key figures, top 5 chapters by
# flow, Trade balance of goods, the neighbouring countries and the history of their top 5 chapters.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NB        <- unlist(params$neighbours)
EXCL_PROD <- c("TOTAL", unlist(params$excluded_products))
yr        <- params$year

# World by product x flow x year
world_py <- ts_world %>% rename(VALUE_W = VALUE)
world_year <- world_py %>% filter(TIME == yr)
w_tot <- function(fl) { v <- world_year$VALUE_W[world_year$PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL" & world_year$FLOW == fl]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }
imp_w <- w_tot("IMPORT"); exp_w <- w_tot("EXPORT"); bal_w <- exp_w - imp_w

# Evolution of the totals
world_tot_ts <- world_py %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = VALUE_W, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(BALANCE = EXPORT - IMPORT) %>% arrange(TIME)

# Top 5 chapters of params$year by flow (TOTAL and excluded chapters is excluded)
top5 <- world_year %>%
  filter(!PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
  group_by(FLOW) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE_W / sum(VALUE_W)) %>%
  slice_max(VALUE_W, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 40, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 38), "…"), PRODUCT_NAME)))

p_top5 <- function(fl) {
  d <- top5 %>% filter(FLOW == fl) %>% arrange(VALUE_W)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~VALUE_W, y = ~LABEL, customdata = ~PRODUCT_CODE, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = FLOW_COLORS[[fl]], line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
          text = ~fmt_pct(SHARE), textposition = "outside", textfont = list(size = 11, color = COL_NAVY), cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertext = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s · %s of %s", LABEL, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(VALUE_W), fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[fl])),
          hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", tickformat = "~s", ticksuffix = "€", fixedrange = TRUE)),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", categoryorder = "trace", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 11), fixedrange = TRUE)),
           bargap = 0.3, margin = list(l = 10, r = 50, t = 10, b = 30)) %>%
    theme_plotly()
}

                    hovertext = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>Exports: %s · Imports: %s<br>Trade balance of goods: %s%s", PARTNER, fmt_eur(EXPORT), fmt_eur(IMPORT), if_else(BALANCE >= 0, "+", "−"), fmt_eur(abs(BALANCE))),

# History: top 5 chapters per year, neighbours summed
nb_hist <- ts_data %>%
  filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% NB, !PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
  group_by(TIME, FLOW, PRODUCT_CODE) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(TIME, FLOW) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE), RANK = rank(-VALUE, ties.method = "first")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 34, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 32), "…"), PRODUCT_NAME)))
nb_top5 <- nb_hist %>% filter(RANK <= 5)

p_anim <- function(fl) {
  d <- nb_top5 %>% filter(FLOW == fl) %>% arrange(TIME, RANK) %>%
    mutate(SHORT = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 24, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 22), "…"), PRODUCT_NAME)),
           TEXT = sprintf("<b>%s</b>  %s · %s", SHORT, fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)),
           HOVER = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%d · rank %d<br>%s: %s · %s of the flow", LABEL, TIME, RANK, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)))
  xmax <- max(d$VALUE) * 2.4                       # room for the label on the right of the bar
  plot_ly(d, x = ~VALUE, y = ~RANK, frame = ~TIME, ids = ~PRODUCT_CODE, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = FLOW_COLORS[[fl]], line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
          text = ~TEXT, textposition = "outside", textfont = list(size = 11, color = COL_NAVY), cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertext = ~HOVER, hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", tickformat = "~s", ticksuffix = "€", range = c(0, xmax))),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", autorange = "reversed", tickvals = 1:5, ticktext = paste0("#", 1:5), range = c(5.6, 0.4), fixedrange = TRUE)),
           bargap = 0.3, margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 70)) %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 1300, transition = 500, easing = "cubic-in-out", redraw = FALSE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year ", font = list(color = COL_NAVY, size = 14)), font = list(size = 10)) %>%
    animation_button(label = "▶ Play", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = -0.35, yanchor = "top") %>%
    theme_plotly()
}

RANK_SCALE <- list(c(0, "#271D67"), c(0.25, "#0E6FA6"), c(0.5, "#1AADE7"), c(0.75, "#8ED2F0"), c(1, "#D3EDF9"))
p_rank <- function(fl) {
  d <- nb_hist %>% filter(FLOW == fl)
  rows <- d %>% filter(RANK <= 5) %>% group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, LABEL) %>%
    summarise(N_TOP = n(), MEAN_RANK = mean(RANK), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(N_TOP), MEAN_RANK)
  yrs <- sort(unique(d$TIME))
  g <- d %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE %in% rows$PRODUCT_CODE) %>%
    select(PRODUCT_CODE, TIME, RANK, VALUE, SHARE, LABEL) %>%
    complete(PRODUCT_CODE = rows$PRODUCT_CODE, TIME = yrs) %>%
    mutate(Z = if_else(!is.na(RANK) & RANK <= 5, as.numeric(RANK), NA_real_),
           TXT = if_else(is.na(Z), "", as.character(RANK)),
           HOVER = if_else(is.na(RANK), "", sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%d · rank %d<br>%s · %s of the %s", LABEL, TIME, RANK, fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[fl])))) %>%
    mutate(PRODUCT_CODE = factor(PRODUCT_CODE, levels = rows$PRODUCT_CODE)) %>% arrange(PRODUCT_CODE, TIME)
  n_r <- nrow(rows); n_c <- length(yrs)
  zmat <- matrix(g$Z, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE); tmat <- matrix(g$TXT, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE); hmat <- matrix(g$HOVER, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE)
  row_lbl <- sprintf("%s  (%d yr%s)", rows$LABEL, rows$N_TOP, if_else(rows$N_TOP > 1, "s", ""))
  # rank numbers as annotations: white on the dark cells (ranks 1-3), navy on the light ones (4-5)
  lab <- g %>% filter(!is.na(Z)) %>%
    mutate(Y = row_lbl[as.integer(PRODUCT_CODE)], COL = if_else(Z <= 3, "#FFFFFF", COL_NAVY))
  ann <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(lab)), function(i)
    list(x = lab$TIME[i], y = lab$Y[i], text = lab$TXT[i], showarrow = FALSE,
         font = list(size = 11, color = lab$COL[i], family = FONT_FAMILY), xref = "x", yref = "y"))
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(type = "heatmap", x = yrs, y = row_lbl, z = zmat,
              hovertext = hmat, hoverinfo = "text",
              colorscale = RANK_SCALE, zmin = 1, zmax = 5, xgap = 3, ygap = 3, showscale = TRUE,
              colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Rank", font = list(size = 11)), tickvals = 1:5, len = 0.6, thickness = 12, outlinewidth = 0)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", dtick = 1, tickangle = -45, tickfont = list(size = 10), showgrid = FALSE,
                                      range = c(min(yrs) - 0.5, max(yrs) + 0.5))),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", type = "category", autorange = "reversed", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 11), showgrid = FALSE)),
           annotations = ann,
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 60)) %>%
    theme_plotly()
}
rank_height <- function(fl) { n <- nb_hist %>% filter(FLOW == fl, RANK <= 5) %>% distinct(PRODUCT_CODE) %>% nrow(); max(260, 30 * n + 120) }

nb_names <- partner_names %>% filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% NB) %>% pull(PARTNER)

# ---- Product dependence matrices
# Per HS2 chapter and flow: value, partner concentration (HHI = sum of squared partner shares),
# top partner. Imports: W = weight in total imports, D = net import dependence = share of the
# chapter's imports not covered by its exports. Exports: W = weight in exports, D = surplus reliance.
# Score = mean of (log-scaled weight, HHI, D) on 0-100; class = number of flags among
# W >= 2 %, HHI >= 0.25, D >= 0.5 (3 = Critical, 2 = High, 1 = Moderate, 0 = Low).
RISK_COLORS <- c(Critical = "#B3261E", High = "#D97A06", Moderate = "#E6B422", Low = "#8ED2F0")
risk_base <- by_partner %>% filter(!PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE)) %>%
  summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), HHI = sum(SHARE^2), TOP1 = PARTNER_CODE[which.max(SHARE)], TOP1_SH = max(SHARE), .groups = "drop")
risk_wide <- risk_base %>% select(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, VALUE) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = VALUE, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(BALANCE = EXPORT - IMPORT)
log_minmax <- function(x) { l <- log10(pmax(x, 1)); (l - min(l)) / (max(l) - min(l)) }
risk_class <- function(flags) factor(c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Critical")[pmin(flags, 3) + 1], levels = names(RISK_COLORS))
risk_table <- function(fl) {
  other <- if (fl == "IMPORT") "EXPORT" else "IMPORT"
  risk_wide %>% filter(.data[[fl]] > 0) %>%
    left_join(risk_base %>% filter(FLOW == fl) %>% select(PRODUCT_CODE, HHI, TOP1, TOP1_SH), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
    mutate(W = .data[[fl]] / sum(.data[[fl]]), W_S = log_minmax(.data[[fl]]), D = pmax(0, 1 - pmin(.data[[other]] / .data[[fl]], 1)),
           SCORE = 100 * (W_S + HHI + D) / 3, FLAGS = (W >= 0.02) + (HHI >= 0.25) + (D >= 0.5), CLASS = risk_class(FLAGS),
           LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", product_names[PRODUCT_CODE]), TOP1_NAME = partner_names$PARTNER[match(TOP1, partner_names$PARTNER_CODE)]) %>%
    arrange(desc(SCORE))
}
risk_imp <- risk_table("IMPORT"); risk_exp <- risk_table("EXPORT")

p_risk_matrix <- function(r, fl) {
  wlab <- if (fl == "IMPORT") "Weight of the product chapter in total imports" else "Weight of the product chapter in total exports"
  dlab <- if (fl == "IMPORT") "net import dependence D" else "surplus reliance D"
  plot_ly(r, x = ~W, y = ~HHI, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
          color = ~CLASS, colors = RISK_COLORS[levels(r$CLASS)],
          marker = list(size = ~8 + 30 * sqrt(D), opacity = 0.85, line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
          hovertext = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s (%s of the total)<br>HHI %.2f · top partner %s (%s)<br>Trade balance of goods: %s · %s = %.2f<br>Score %.0f · %s",
                               LABEL, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(.data[[fl]]), fmt_pct(W), HHI, TOP1_NAME, fmt_pct(TOP1_SH), paste0(if_else(BALANCE >= 0, "+", "−"), fmt_eur(abs(BALANCE))), dlab, D, SCORE, CLASS),
          hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    add_annotations(data = filter(r, CLASS == "Critical" | (CLASS == "High" & W >= 0.005)), x = ~log10(W), y = ~HHI, text = ~PRODUCT_CODE,
                    showarrow = FALSE, yshift = 14, font = list(size = 10, color = COL_NAVY)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = wlab, type = "log", tickvals = c(1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2), ticktext = c("0.01%", "0.1%", "1%", "2%", "5%", "10%", "20%"))),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "Partner concentration (HHI)", range = c(0, 1.05))),
           shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = 0.02, x1 = 0.02, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, line = list(color = COL_GREY, dash = "dot")),
                         list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0.25, y1 = 0.25, line = list(color = COL_GREY, dash = "dot"))),
           legend = list(title = list(text = "Risk class"), orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.2),
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 70)) %>% theme_plotly()
}
n_crit <- sum(risk_imp$CLASS == "Critical"); v_crit <- sum(risk_imp$IMPORT[risk_imp$CLASS == "Critical"])
```

```{r hs4-drill}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TAB - drilldown of the top 5 charts: select a HS2 chapter -> its HS4 headings.
# Source: params$hs4_path (Eurostat JSON-stat, reporter x WORLD x HS4 x flow x indicator x year).
# Bar labels = share of the chapter (the headings + "Other" add up to 100%); the hover also gives the share of the
# total flow (same denominator as the top 5: total of the flow, excluded chapters is excluded).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
read_jsonstat <- function(path) {
  x     <- jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  ids   <- unlist(x$id)
  size  <- as.integer(unlist(x$size))
  codes <- lapply(ids, function(d) {
    idx <- x$dimension[[d]]$category$index
    if (!is.null(names(idx))) names(idx)[order(unlist(idx))] else unlist(idx)
  })
  strides <- rev(cumprod(rev(c(size[-1], 1L))))          # JSON-stat: the last dimension varies fastest
  v <- x$value
  if (!is.null(names(v))) {                               # sparse format: { "index": value }
    k <- as.integer(names(v)); val <- as.numeric(unlist(lapply(v, function(e) if (is.null(e)) NA else e)))
  } else {
    keep <- !vapply(v, is.null, logical(1)); k <- which(keep) - 1L; val <- as.numeric(unlist(v[keep]))
  }
  out <- tibble(VALUE = val)
  for (i in seq_along(ids)) out[[ids[i]]] <- codes[[i]][(k %/% strides[i]) %% size[i] + 1L]
  list(data = out, labels = lapply(setNames(ids, ids), function(d) unlist(x$dimension[[d]]$category$label)))
}

HS4_N    <- as.integer(params$hs4_n)
HS4_OK   <- FALSE
HS4_NOTE <- NULL
DRILL    <- setNames(lapply(names(FLOW_COLORS), function(f) list()), names(FLOW_COLORS))

if (nzchar(params$hs4_path) && file.exists(params$hs4_path)) {
  js4    <- read_jsonstat(params$hs4_path)
  lab4   <- js4$labels$product
  flow4  <- js4$labels$flow
  hs4 <- js4$data %>%
    filter(indicators == "VALUE_IN_EUROS",
           grepl("^[0-9]{4}$|^[0-9]{2}XX$", product),     # 6- and 8-digit codes are duplicates of their heading
           !is.na(VALUE), VALUE > 0) %>%
    mutate(FLOW    = toupper(coalesce(unname(flow4[flow]), flow)),
           FLOW    = recode(FLOW, "1" = "IMPORT", "2" = "EXPORT"),
           CHAPTER = substr(product, 1, 2),
           TIME    = as.integer(time))

  if (!any(hs4$TIME == yr)) {
    HS4_NOTE <- sprintf("4-digit file has no data for %d (years: %s)", yr, paste(sort(unique(hs4$TIME)), collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    hs4 <- filter(hs4, TIME == yr)
    den <- world_year %>% filter(!PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
      group_by(FLOW) %>% summarise(DEN = sum(VALUE_W), .groups = "drop")
    den <- setNames(den$DEN, den$FLOW)

    short <- function(s, n = 40) if_else(nchar(s) > n, paste0(str_sub(s, 1, n - 2), "…"), s)
    hs4_name <- function(code) {
      nm <- unname(lab4[code])
      nm <- if_else(grepl("XX$", code), sprintf("Product chapter %s, not elsewhere specified", substr(code, 1, 2)), nm)
      coalesce(nm, code)
    }

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(top5))) {
      fl <- top5$FLOW[i]; ch <- top5$PRODUCT_CODE[i]; ch_val <- top5$VALUE_W[i]
      kids  <- hs4 %>% filter(FLOW == fl, CHAPTER == ch) %>% arrange(desc(VALUE))
      if (nrow(kids) == 0) next
      shown <- head(filter(kids, VALUE >= 0.01 * ch_val), HS4_N)   # headings >= 1% of the chapter, the rest folded
      d <- tibble(CODE = shown$product, NAME = hs4_name(shown$product), VALUE = shown$VALUE, OTHER = FALSE)
      rest  <- ch_val - sum(shown$VALUE)                  # closes the gap to the chapter bar
      n_rest <- nrow(kids) - nrow(shown)
      if (rest > 0.001 * ch_val) {
        d <- bind_rows(tibble(CODE = paste0(ch, "··"),
                              NAME = if (n_rest > 0) sprintf("Other headings of product chapter %s (%d)", ch, n_rest) else sprintf("Product chapter %s, not allocated", ch),
                              VALUE = rest, OTHER = TRUE),
                       arrange(d, VALUE))                 # bottom = "Other", then the headings in ascending order
      } else {
        d <- arrange(d, VALUE)
      }
      d <- d %>% mutate(
        SHARE  = VALUE / den[[fl]],
        CH_SH  = VALUE / ch_val,
        LABEL  = if_else(OTHER, NAME, paste0(CODE, " · ", short(NAME))),
        HOVER  = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s · %s of product chapter %s · %s of total %s",
                         gsub("\n", "<br>", str_wrap(if_else(OTHER, NAME, paste0(CODE, " · ", NAME)), 60)), FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(VALUE),
                         fmt_pct(CH_SH), ch, fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[fl])),
        COLOR  = if_else(OTHER, "#C9C4EC", FLOW_COLORS[[fl]])
      )
      DRILL[[fl]][[ch]] <- list(
        chapter = top5$LABEL[i], share = fmt_pct(top5$SHARE[i]), n = nrow(kids),
        code = I(d$CODE), label = I(d$LABEL), value = I(signif(d$VALUE, 8)), text = I(if_else(d$CH_SH < 0.001, "<0.1%", fmt_pct(d$CH_SH))),
        hover = I(d$HOVER), color = I(d$COLOR), other = I(d$OTHER)
      )
    }
    HS4_OK <- sum(lengths(DRILL)) > 0
    if (!HS4_OK) HS4_NOTE <- "no 4-digit heading found for the top 5 chapters"
  }
} else if (nzchar(params$hs4_path)) {
  HS4_NOTE <- sprintf("4-digit file '%s' not found next to the Rmd", params$hs4_path)
}
```

```{r cockpit}
    tags$b("What to look for: "),
    "Large bubbles in the upper-right corner signal economically significant, ",
    "concentrated and imbalanced trade. In 2025, four product chapters are ",
    "critical on the import side, accounting for ",
    tags$b("25.5% of total imports"),
    "."
  ),

  tags$p(
    tags$em("Note: Product chapter 99 is excluded.")
  )
),
  div(
    class = "card-grid",
    div(class = "card-box", div(class = "card-title", sprintf("Import dependence · %d", yr)),
        div(class = "card-sub", "Weight × supplier concentration × net import dependence · labels = Critical and High chapters · dotted lines = 2 % weight and HHI 0.25"),
        with_h(p_risk_matrix(risk_imp, "IMPORT"), 520)),
    div(class = "card-box", div(class = "card-title", sprintf("Export dependence · %d", yr)),
        div(class = "card-sub", "Weight × market concentration × surplus reliance · same axes and thresholds"),
        with_h(p_risk_matrix(risk_exp, "EXPORT"), 520))
  )
)

) else div(

      sprintf("For each HS2 product chapter, we compare the share of total exports accounted for by that product in each country. The smaller of the two shares contributes to the score. Adding these contributions gives the overall similarity score, from 0 to 100.", params$reporter)),

      div(class = "card-sub", sprintf("Each bar is a product chapter's share of the country's total · navy = the smaller of the two shares, mirrored on both sides, adds up to the score · light = what only one of the two has · chapters beyond the %d largest are folded into \"Other chapters\"", NR)),

      div(class = "card-sub", sprintf("Each cell = the points a product chapter contributes to a country's score (the part of the basket shared with %s) · the %d chapters that tie the 5 closest twins most · a dark cell is a product chapter that really ties the two economies together", params$reporter, NR)),
      div(id = "tw-heat-wrap", with_h(p_tw_heat, max(340, 34 * NR + 130)))),
  div(class = "card-box", div(class = "card-title", span("Selected product · ", span(id = "tw-product-name", "–"))),
      div(class = "card-sub", sprintf("Which countries have a similar share of this product in their exports? Bars show each country's share of this product chapter in the selected flow. The dashed red line marks %s's share. Countries are ranked by their distance from %s's share, with the three closest matches highlighted in blue. Labels show the difference in percentage points.", params$reporter, params$reporter)),
      div(id = "tw-pick-wrap", with_h(p_tw_pick, max(320, 34 * params$twins_countries + 120))),
      p(class = "note", id = "tw-s-product", ""))
)

main <- div(class = "cockpit-main", summary_tab, overview_tab, product_tab, country_tab, twins_tab)

div(class = "cockpit", sidebar, main)
```
